purpose: Test conservative reduced-state sufficiency for groundwater recharge, capillary rise and drainage/capillary regime transitions before any LARE closure is introduced.

reference_policy.route: current admitted Reference Richards research observation seam
reference_policy.fallback_policy: reuse the already-qualified strict-first ROM1AR2 total/local representation-floor research policy unchanged where still source-compatible; otherwise fail closed and reconcile before scientific interpretation

known_control.role: failure-mode control only; the old reduced dynamics is not reused
known_control.required_metric: terminal bottom-flux sign and reversal timing remain explicit diagnostics in RS1-GW

histories.role: exact forcing-shape control inherited from held-out H02

state_candidates.enumeration: all contiguous fixed partitions of the 16 base cells for dimensions 2 through 10
state_candidates.state: exact layer storage W_i, represented equivalently as layer mean theta for fixed thickness
state_candidates.selection_rule: state-collision census only proposes candidates; no candidate is accepted until future-response ambiguity is tested against a separately frozen purpose envelope

future_probe_policy.pair_selection: cross-history nearest collisions are frozen before future response is evaluated
future_probe_policy.horizons: short, intermediate and long horizons are frozen before probe execution; no horizon selected from candidate error

acceptance_envelope_rule: Numerical full-state separation is diagnostic only. A reduced-state collision fails RS1-GW only when identical future forcing produces a preregistered groundwater-purpose output difference outside the independently frozen hydrological acceptance envelope.

stage_B_not_yet_authorized.rule: Stage B requires a new preregistration after Stage A reference reachability and numerical robustness are known; candidate outcomes may not be used to tune Stage A retrospectively.
